args.description: Training table for Retail Win-back from the United Kingdom orders only: one row per shopper active on or before the snapshot, behaviour read up to it, and reactivated is 1 when the shopper ordered again in the 60 days after it.
args.sql:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, InvoiceNo, CAST(InvoiceDate AS DATE) AS d, Quantity * UnitPrice AS amt
  FROM t_order_log
  WHERE Country = 'United Kingdom' AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
f AS (
  SELECT CustomerID,
    date_diff('day', max(d), $as_of) AS days_since_last_order,
    count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d > $as_of - INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN InvoiceNo END) AS orders_90d,
    count(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) FILTER (WHERE d > $as_of - INTERVAL '365' DAY) AS orders_365d,
    coalesce(sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE d > $as_of - INTERVAL '90' DAY), 0) AS spend_90d,
    coalesce(sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE d > $as_of - INTERVAL '365' DAY), 0) AS spend_365d,
    sum(amt) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT InvoiceNo), 0) AS avg_order_value
  FROM o WHERE d <= $as_of GROUP BY CustomerID
),
y AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM o WHERE d > $as_of AND d <= $as_of + INTERVAL '60' DAY
)
SELECT f.CustomerID, f.days_since_last_order, f.orders_90d, f.orders_365d, f.spend_90d, f.spend_365d,
       f.avg_order_value, (y.CustomerID IS NOT NULL) AS reactivated
FROM f LEFT JOIN y ON y.CustomerID = f.CustomerID
